svc_detailed_engineering.title: Projects Construction
svc_detailed_engineering.summary: Reliable Construction Services for Complex Projects
svc_detailed_engineering.description:
As your trusted partner and advocate, we draw on our network of local and global resources, while applying practical know-how to ensure your project is successfully managed from concept to completion and turnover.

We have successfully realized some of the world’s most iconic structures and developments for clients that include public and private developers, companies, and institutions.

From site preparation and civil works to structural construction, MEP installation, finishing works, and project handover, we manage every stage of construction using internationally recognized quality standards and proven construction methodologies.

Our commitment to collaboration, planning, and technical excellence enables us to successfully deliver projects that meet client expectations while supporting long-term operational performance.

svc_procurement_expediting.title: Procurement & Supply Chain
svc_procurement_expediting.summary: Reliable Procurement Solutions for Efficient Project Delivery
svc_procurement_expediting.description:
Infra Construction provides strategic procurement and supply chain management services that ensure timely material availability, cost efficiency, and operational continuity.

Efficient procurement and reliable supply chain management are essential to successful project delivery. Infra Construction provides integrated procurement solutions that ensure materials, equipment, and services are sourced efficiently while maintaining quality, compliance, and cost control.

Our procurement specialists work closely with trusted suppliers and logistics partners to support infrastructure and industrial projects across multiple sectors. Through strategic sourcing, supplier evaluation, and effective logistics coordination, we help clients reduce procurement risks and maintain uninterrupted project progress.

Our supply chain strategies are designed to improve operational efficiency while supporting project schedules and long-term business objectives.
svc_procurement_expediting.capabilities:
Strategic Sourcing
Supplier Evaluation & Qualification
Procurement Planning
Tender Management
Contract Negotiation
Logistics & Transportation Coordination
Inventory Management
Supply Chain Optimization
Vendor Performance Management

svc_construction_services.title: Value Engineering & Cost Management
svc_construction_services.summary: Optimizing Project Value Throughout the Project Lifecycle
svc_construction_services.description:
Infra Construction provides value engineering and cost management services that improve project efficiency, optimize budgets, and support sustainable project delivery.

Effective project delivery requires balancing performance, quality, and cost. Infra Construction provides value engineering and cost management services that help clients optimize project resources while maintaining technical integrity and operational performance.

Our specialists evaluate engineering solutions, construction methodologies, procurement strategies, and lifecycle costs to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and measurable
cost savings. Through detailed financial planning and engineering analysis, we help clients make informed decisions that reduce waste, enhance project value, and support long-term
operational sustainability.

By integrating value engineering early in the project lifecycle, we contribute to better budget control, improved resource utilization, and greater confidence throughout project execution.
svc_construction_services.capabilities:
Value Engineering Studies
Cost Planning & Budget Development
Cost Estimation & Quantity Surveying
Lifecycle Cost Analysis
Cost Control & Financial Monitoring
Procurement Cost Optimization
Risk & Contingency Planning
Project Cost Reporting

svc_construction_management.title: Engineering & Detailed Construction Designs
svc_construction_management.summary: Transforming Concepts into Buildable Engineering Solutions
svc_construction_management.description:
We collaborate with client counterparts to design complex projects that may include engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, maintenance and project management (EPCM). From the earliest stages of project design, we involve the construction and commissioning teams to provide capital cost and schedule efficiency.

Every successful project begins with a clear engineering vision and technically coordinated design. At Infra Construction (IC), we deliver comprehensive engineering and detailed construction design services that convert project concepts into practical, efficient, and fully executable solutions.

Our multidisciplinary engineering teams develop architectural, structural, civil, infrastructure, and MEP designs that comply with international engineering standards while meeting local regulatory requirements. By integrating advanced engineering practices, Building Information Modeling (BIM), and collaborative design processes, we help clients improve constructability, reduce project risks, and optimize long-term asset performance.

From concept development through detailed construction documentation, our focus is on delivering engineering solutions that support quality construction, efficient execution, and sustainable infrastructure development.
svc_construction_management.capabilities:
Architectural & Master Planning Design
Structural Engineering, Civil & Infrastructure Design
Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing (MEP) Engineering
Detailed Construction Drawings 
Shop Drawings & Technical Documentation
BIM Coordination & Clash Detection 
Design Review & Engineering Optimization
Sustainable & Energy-Efficient Design Solutions

svc_facilities_management.title: Projects Construction Management
svc_facilities_management.summary: Integrated Leadership for Successful Project Delivery
svc_facilities_management.description:
We are uniquely positioned to leverage our extensive experience to deliver comprehensive project management services. 

Successful construction projects require effective planning, coordination, and continuous oversight. Infra Construction provides integrated construction management services that ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with established quality, cost, and schedule objectives. 

Our project management professionals coordinate contractors, consultants, suppliers, and stakeholders while monitoring project progress, managing risks, and maintaining transparent communication throughout every project phase. 

Using internationally recognized project management practices and advanced reporting systems, we help clients maintain control, improve decision-making, and achieve successful project outcomes.
svc_facilities_management.capabilities:
Project Planning & Scheduling
Construction Supervision
Contract Administration
Project Controls
Risk Management
Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)
Progress Monitoring & Reporting
Stakeholder Coordination
Project Closeout & Handover

svc_operation_maintenance.title: Facilities Management
svc_operation_maintenance.description:
We are uniquely positioned to leverage our extensive experience to deliver comprehensive Facilities management services.

Maintaining the performance of buildings and infrastructure requires a structured approach to operations and maintenance. Infra Construction provides integrated facilities management services that help organizations maximize asset value while ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operations.

Our services cover both hard and soft facilities management, including technical maintenance, asset management, building operations, energy management, and support services. Through preventive maintenance strategies and performance monitoring, we help clients reduce operational disruptions, improve energy efficiency, and extend asset life cycles.

By combining technical expertise with proactive service delivery, we create operational environments that remain efficient, compliant, and sustainable throughout their lifecycle.
svc_operation_maintenance.capabilities:
Building Operations & Maintenance
Preventive & Corrective Maintenance
Asset Lifecycle Management
Energy Management
Technical Support Services
Cleaning & Housekeeping
Health, Safety & Compliance
Performance Monitoring & Reporting

sct_built_environment.title: Built Environment
sct_built_environment.summary: High-complexity building structures, public architecture, and commercial facilities.
sct_built_environment.description:
The Built Environment division at IC focuses on high-complexity building structures, public architecture, and commercial facilities.
We manage the entire project lifecycle — from pre-construction design review and civil execution to structural fit-outs, building services integration, and final commissioning.
sct_built_environment.capabilities: Healthcare Infrastructure, Educational Facilities, Tourism & Entertainment, Residential Sector, Public & Commercial Buildings, Special Buildings

sub_built_environment_healthcare_infrast.title: Healthcare Infrastructure
sub_built_environment_healthcare_infrast.description:
IC delivers specialized medical facilities engineered to meet international healthcare design and infection control standards. Our capabilities span the construction of general hospital complexes, diagnostic centers, specialized outpatient clinics, and high-capacity kidney dialysis facilities.
We integrate complex mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, medical gas networks, cleanroom environments, and emergency power supply infrastructures necessary for critical care environments.

sub_built_environment_educational_facili.title: Educational Facilities
sub_built_environment_educational_facili.description:
We build educational infrastructure designed to support modern learning, research, and campus logistics. Our experience includes the turnkey delivery of university campuses, administrative buildings, technical institutes, research laboratories, and primary/secondary school complexes.
The scope encompasses heavy structural civil works, material procurement, acoustic and climate-controlled finishing, and complete site infrastructure.

sub_built_environment_tourism_entertainm.title: Tourism & Entertainment
sub_built_environment_tourism_entertainm.description:
IC provides engineering and construction services for the hospitality and commercial leisure sectors. We execute structural and architectural works for high-end hotel developments, beachfront resort complexes, cultural centers, and public entertainment hubs.
Our teams balance aesthetic requirements with structural durability, ensuring full compliance with international safety, accessibility, and environmental standards.

sub_built_environment_residential_sector.title: Residential Sector
sub_built_environment_residential_sector.description:
Our residential portfolio addresses both public development initiatives and private real estate demand. We execute large-scale social housing programs, integrated gated residential communities, mixed-use residential towers, and custom luxury villas.
IC emphasizes structural durability, energy-efficient building envelopes, and complete site integration, including internal road networks, landscaping, and residential utility hookups.

sub_built_environment_public_commercial_.title: Public & Commercial Buildings
sub_built_environment_public_commercial_.description:
IC delivers complex public and commercial developments designed to support governmental operations, business activities, and community services. Our expertise covers the construction of government administrative buildings, municipal facilities, corporate headquarters, office complexes, financial institutions, retail developments, shopping malls, convention and exhibition centers, and mixed-use commercial projects.
We execute complete structural, architectural, and MEP works while integrating intelligent building systems, fire and life safety solutions, energy-efficient technologies, and sustainable construction practices to ensure long-term operational performance and compliance with international standards.

sub_built_environment_special_buildings.title: Special Buildings
sub_built_environment_special_buildings.description:
IC specializes in the delivery of technically demanding and purpose-built facilities that require advanced engineering solutions, specialized construction methodologies, and stringent operational requirements. Our capabilities include the construction of data centers, command and control centers, security and defense facilities, industrial support buildings, laboratories, logistics hubs, and mission-critical operational facilities.
These projects involve high-performance structural systems, specialized MEP installations, controlled environments, security infrastructure, and resilient utility networks designed to achieve maximum reliability, operational continuity, and compliance with international technical and safety standards.

sct_infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
sct_infrastructure.summary: Water and wastewater systems, dams and irrigation, ports and marine works, airports, roads and bridges, and energy and power infrastructure.
sct_infrastructure.description: IC’s Infrastructure division handles heavy civil engineering, utility networks, marine works, and energy transportation systems designed to withstand demanding environmental conditions and long-term operational demands.
sct_infrastructure.capabilities: Infrastructure, Dams and Irrigation, Ports & Marine Works, Airports, Roads, Highways & Bridges, Energy Infrastructure, Power Generation & Distribution

sub_infrastructure_Infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
sub_infrastructure_Infrastructure.description: IC implements complete water lifecycle engineering solutions. Our operational scope includes:
sub_infrastructure_Infrastructure.points:
Wastewater Treatment & Collection: Construction of municipal sewage treatment plants (STPs), pumping stations, trunk sewers, and deep gravity collection networks.
Marine Outfalls & Treatment: Engineering marine water treatment systems and coastal discharge infrastructure designed to protect marine ecosystems.
Water Reuse & Conservation: Development of tertiary treatment systems, industrial effluent recycling facilities, and non-revenue water (NRW) reduction networks.

sub_infrastructure_dams_irrigation.title: Dams and Irrigation
sub_infrastructure_dams_irrigation.description: To combat water scarcity and support agricultural development in arid regions, IC constructs water retention and diversion infrastructure:
sub_infrastructure_dams_irrigation.points:
Dam Construction: Engineering earth-fill, rock-fill, and concrete dams for flood control, stormwater management, and strategic water storage.
Irrigation Networks: Designing and installing primary and secondary irrigation canals, pressurized water distribution pipes, agricultural pumping stations, and control gates.

sub_infrastructure_ports_marine_works.title: Ports & Marine Works
sub_infrastructure_ports_marine_works.description: IC delivers specialized marine construction and coastal engineering solutions:
sub_infrastructure_ports_marine_works.points:
Port Facilities: Construction of commercial fishing ports, cargo handling quays, and vessel berth infrastructures.
Coastal Protection: Fabrication and placement of marine breakwaters, riprap slope protection, and shoreline stabilization systems.
Floating & Fixed Structures: Engineering floating pontoon systems, concrete jetties, and marine access walkways.

sub_infrastructure_airports.title: Airports
sub_infrastructure_airports.description: We support civil aviation authorities and airport operators with specialized airside and landside construction services:
sub_infrastructure_airports.points:
Facilities Rehabilitation: Upgrading, expanding, and modernizing existing passenger terminals, cargo hangars, and administrative buildings.
Airside Infrastructure: Civil works for runway expansions, taxiway overlays, apron pavements, and specialized drainage networks.

sub_infrastructure_roads_highways_bridge.title: Roads, Highways & Bridges
sub_infrastructure_roads_highways_bridge.description: IC manages comprehensive transportation infrastructure programs from ground preparation to final surfacing:
sub_infrastructure_roads_highways_bridge.points:
Highway & Urban Road Construction: Grading, paving, and surfacing for multi-lane intercity highways, arterial urban roads, and industrial corridors.
Bridges & Overpasses: Structural execution of reinforced concrete and steel bridges, flyovers, grade-separated interchanges, and pedestrian crossings.
Traffic & Maintenance Systems: Installation of signage, safety barriers, intelligent transport system (ITS) conduits, and ongoing highway maintenance programs.

sub_infrastructure_energy_infrastructure.title: Energy Infrastructure
sub_infrastructure_energy_infrastructure.description: We execute civil works and structural installations for conventional and renewable energy developments:
sub_infrastructure_energy_infrastructure.points:
Renewable Energy Integration: Site preparation, foundation civil engineering, and structural installations for solar PV parks and utility-scale renewable facilities.
Sustainable Power Assets: Civil infrastructure for clean energy plants and industrial energy recovery systems.

sub_infrastructure_power_generation_dist.title: Power Generation & Distribution
sub_infrastructure_power_generation_dist.description: IC supports national power grids through heavy power plant engineering and distribution network execution:
sub_infrastructure_power_generation_dist.points:
Power Generation Facilities: Civil works, equipment foundations, and structural framing for thermal, steam, and gas turbine power stations.
Substations & Grid Connection: Construction of high-voltage indoor and outdoor substations, including transformer pads, control buildings, and switchyards.
Transmission & Distribution Networks: Installation of overhead transmission line towers, underground high-voltage cabling networks, and regional distribution grids.

We are devoted to understanding every client's needs and continually developing the techniques and procedures of construction.
about_mvp.visionText: With a focus on outstanding time, cost, and resources management, our company strives to assume a significant role in the construction of Mega projects across various domains. By adhering to the best practices in project and construction management, we consistently deliver exceptional results.
about_mvp.philosophyText: Infra Construction works to introduce excellent ways of management for a wide range of project types. All projects are managed to achieve the best goals of Scope, Time, Cost & Quality — on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

about_story_full.title: A Legacy of Building the World
about_story_full.p1: Actualizing design and shop drawings is our main critical mission — implemented based on past experiences and the vast knowledge of our engineers. Infra Construction is a contracting company that has carried out numerous and various projects since its establishment in 2000.
about_story_full.p2: Every task Infra Construction took up was executed through hard work and dedication from our team professionals. Possessing all the needed resources is a crucial factor in achieving any project successfully — however, the factor that delivers outstanding results is managing these resources optimally.
about_story_full.p3: Infra Construction represents the working arm providing professional services in the contracting niche — especially in the infrastructure field — executing according to international codes and project specifications across the UAE, Egypt, Yemen, and Canada.

about_ceo_bio.bio1: As Founder and Chief Executive Officer of INFRA Construction, Mr. Hany El-Sahooly has led the company since its establishment in 2000 — shaping it into a trusted name in buildings, infrastructure, and industrial construction across the Middle East, Africa, and North America.
about_ceo_bio.bio2: His vision drives every project we deliver — built on integrity, engineering excellence, and a commitment to exceeding client expectations at every step.

about_intro.title: Two Decades of Infrastructure Excellence
about_intro.p1: INFRA Construction was established in 2000 with a clear mission: to deliver complex infrastructure and construction projects to international standards in markets where excellence is most needed. From a specialist contractor serving the Middle East, INFRA has grown into a multi-sector, multi-regional construction group operating across the UAE, Egypt, Yemen, Jordan, Canada, and East Africa.
about_intro.p2: Today, INFRA Construction operates as a member of HS Group — delivering projects across Buildings & Architecture, Infrastructure & Civil Works, Water & Utilities, Energy & Power, Industrial & Oil Services, Engineering & EPC, and Facilities Management. Our integrated capabilities allow us to serve as a single trusted partner from project inception through long-term operations.
about_intro.p3: Backed by ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, certifications, our commitment to quality, safety, and environmental responsibility is embedded in every project we undertake.

about_quote.text: Engineering integrity, safety, and on-time delivery are non-negotiable. We invest in people, plant, and partnerships that compound over years.
about_quote.author: INFRA Construction — Operating Philosophy

about_foundation.title: Built on Engineering Discipline
about_foundation.p1: INFRA Construction was established in 2000 as a specialist contracting company, with the goal of delivering complex infrastructure work to international standards. The company's foundation rests on engineering discipline, operational integrity, and a commitment to delivering every project safely, on time, and to specification.
about_foundation.p2: Over more than two decades, INFRA has expanded its capabilities, its geographic reach, and its sector coverage — evolving from a regional contractor into a multi-disciplinary construction group with a presence across the Middle East, Africa, and Canada.
about_foundation.p3: INFRA is a member of HS Group, which provides the group-level strategic direction, financial backing, and executive leadership that enables INFRA to compete for and deliver major programmes across international markets.

about_future.title: Our Vision for the Future
about_future.p1: INFRA Construction continues to expand its geographic reach, deepen its sector capabilities, and strengthen its partnerships across the Middle East, Africa, and beyond. Our strategic priorities include growing our presence in East Africa, expanding our engineering and EPC capabilities, and investing in digital project delivery technologies.
about_future.p2: We remain committed to our core values: engineering excellence, operational safety, client partnership, and long-term value creation for every stakeholder we work with.

news_7.title: We are pleased to announce the start of construction works for the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Cold Storage Expansion Project in Abu Dhabi
news_7.excerpt: We are pleased to announce the start of construction works for the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Cold Storage Expansion Project in Abu Dhabi, delivered by Infra Construction in partnership with STBM for the Abu Dhabi Municipality.
news_7.author: INFRA Communications
news_7.p1:
We are pleased to announce the start of construction works for the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Cold Storage Expansion Project in Abu Dhabi, delivered by Infra Construction in partnership with STBM for the Abu Dhabi Municipality.
The project marks another step toward enhancing service facilities and strengthening infrastructure that supports the food security ecosystem in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.
news_7.p2:
Our technical teams have officially commenced on-site activities, including site preparation, safety setup, excavation, and initial groundwork, paving the way for the next phases of construction in line with the approved project schedule.
The scope of the project includes the construction of new steel structure buildings, featuring the following: Expansion of the existing meat cold storage facility. Expansion of the ticketing area and public hall. Development of a new dedicated meat cooling zone.
news_7.p3: These upgrades form part of an integrated development plan aimed at improving operational efficiency and enhancing the overall functionality of the facility.
news_7.p4:
The project is scheduled to be completed within six months, with execution carried out according to the highest engineering and construction standards to ensure quality, reliability, and operational performance.
At Infra Construction, we remain committed to contributing to the development of vital infrastructure projects in Abu Dhabi and delivering construction solutions that create long-term value and support sustainable development.
